info.title: Xproapi.com
info.description:
## Xproapi.com

This collection provides a comprehensive set of endpoints for interacting with the **Xproapi.com** API — a platform for accessing X (formerly Twitter) data programmatically.

### What's included

- **Users** — Retrieve user profiles, search for users, and fetch batch user information by user IDs or usernames.
    
- **Tweets** — Access tweet timelines, fetch the latest tweets, retrieve tweets by ID, and run advanced searches.
    
- **Tweet Activity** — Explore tweet engagement data including replies, quotes, retweets, thread context, and user tweet timelines.
    
- **Follow & Followings** — Look up a user's followers and the accounts they follow.
    
- **Mentions** — Retrieve tweets in which a specific user has been mentioned.
    
- **Articles** — Fetch article content associated with a user or post.
    

### Authentication

Requests use an API key passed via the `key` variable. Set the `base_url` and `key` variables in the **Production** environment before sending requests.

## Get User Profile About

Retrieves extended profile information and "About" section details for a specified Twitter/X user.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `userName` | string | ✅ Required | The Twitter/X username (without @). Example: `elonmusk` |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/user_about?userName=elonmusk
```

### Example Response

Returns extended user profile data including:
- `id` — Twitter user ID
- `name` — Display name
- `userName` — Username handle
- `bio` — Profile biography
- `location` — User's listed location
- `website` — Profile website URL
- `joinedDate` — Account creation date
- `followersCount` — Number of followers
- `followingCount` — Number of accounts following
- `tweetsCount` — Total number of tweets
- `isVerified` — Verification status
- `pinnedTweet` — The user's pinned tweet (if any)

## Search Users

Searches for Twitter/X users matching a given query string.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | string | ✅ Required | Search query to find users. Can be a name, username, or keyword. Example: `bitcoin` |
| `cursor` | string | Optional | Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/user/search?query=bitcoin&cursor=
```

### Example Response

Returns a paginated list of user objects matching the query, each containing:
- `id` — Twitter user ID
- `name` — Display name
- `userName` — Username handle
- `bio` — Profile biography
- `followersCount` — Number of followers
- `isVerified` — Verification status
- `cursor` — Pagination cursor for the next page

## Batch User Info by User IDs

Retrieves profile information for multiple Twitter/X users in a single request using their numeric user IDs.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `userIds` | string | ✅ Required | Comma-separated list of numeric Twitter user IDs. Example: `1655837182773563392,3295112503` |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/user/batch_info_by_ids?userIds=1655837182773563392,3295112503
```

### Notes
- You can pass a single user ID or multiple IDs separated by commas.
- Maximum recommended batch size: 100 user IDs per request.

### Example Response

Returns an array of user profile objects, each containing:
- `id` — Twitter user ID
- `name` — Display name
- `userName` — Username handle
- `bio` — Profile biography
- `followersCount` — Number of followers
- `followingCount` — Number of accounts following
- `tweetsCount` — Total number of tweets
- `isVerified` — Verification status
- `profileImageUrl` — Profile picture URL

## Get User Tweet Timeline

Retrieves the tweet timeline for a specified Twitter/X user, including their tweets and retweets in chronological order.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `userName` | string | ✅ Required | The Twitter/X username (without @). Example: `elonmusk` |
| `cursor` | string | Optional | Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of the timeline |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/user/tweet_timeline?userName=elonmusk
```

### Example Response

Returns a paginated timeline of tweet objects, each containing:
- `id` — Tweet ID
- `text` — Tweet content
- `author` — Author user object
- `createdAt` — Timestamp
- `likeCount`, `replyCount`, `retweetCount`, `viewCount` — Engagement metrics
- `isRetweet` — Whether this is a retweet
- `cursor` — Pagination cursor for the next page

## Get Tweets by IDs

Retrieves detailed information for one or more tweets by their IDs in a single batch request.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tweet_ids` | string | ✅ Required | Comma-separated list of tweet IDs to fetch. Example: `2104402989570297895,2104396243434651759` |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/tweets?tweet_ids=2104402989570297895,2104396243434651759
```

### Notes
- You can pass a single tweet ID or multiple IDs separated by commas.
- Maximum recommended batch size: 100 tweet IDs per request.

### Example Response

Returns an array of tweet objects, each containing:
- `id` — Tweet ID
- `text` — Tweet content
- `author` — Author user object (id, name, userName, followersCount)
- `createdAt` — Timestamp
- `likeCount`, `replyCount`, `retweetCount`, `viewCount` — Engagement metrics
- `media` — Attached media if any
- `urls` — Expanded URLs in the tweet

## Advanced Tweet Search

Searches for tweets using advanced query syntax, supporting filters by user, keyword, hashtag, date range, and more.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | string | ✅ Required | Advanced search query string. Supports Twitter search operators. Example: `from:elonmusk starship` |
| `queryType` | string | Optional | Sort order of results. Values: `Latest` (default) or `Top` |
| `cursor` | string | Optional | Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results |

### Supported Query Operators

| Operator | Example | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `from:` | `from:elonmusk` | Tweets from a specific user |
| `to:` | `to:nasa` | Tweets replying to a user |
| `#` | `#bitcoin` | Tweets with a specific hashtag |
| `"..."` | `"climate change"` | Exact phrase match |
| `-` | `-spam` | Exclude a keyword |
| `lang:` | `lang:en` | Filter by language |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/tweet/advanced_search?query=from:elonmusk%20starship&queryType=Latest
```

### Example Response

Returns a paginated list of matching tweet objects, each containing:
- `id` — Tweet ID
- `text` — Tweet content
- `author` — Author user object
- `createdAt` — Timestamp
- `likeCount`, `replyCount`, `retweetCount`, `viewCount` — Engagement metrics
- `cursor` — Pagination cursor for the next page

## Get Tweet Replies (v2)

Retrieves replies to a specific tweet using the v2 endpoint, with support for relevance-based or latest sorting.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tweetId` | string | ✅ Required | The unique ID of the tweet to fetch replies for. Example: `2109692430178255016` |
| `queryType` | string | Optional | Sort order of replies. Values: `Relevance` (default) or `Latest` |
| `cursor` | string | Optional | Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of replies |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/tweet/replies/v2?tweetId=2109692430178255016&queryType=Relevance
```

### Example Response

Returns a paginated list of reply tweet objects, each containing:
- `id` — Tweet ID
- `text` — Reply text content
- `author` — Author user object (id, name, userName)
- `createdAt` — Timestamp of the reply
- `likeCount`, `replyCount`, `retweetCount` — Engagement metrics
- `cursor` — Pagination cursor for the next page

## Get Tweet Thread Context

Retrieves the full thread context of a tweet, including parent tweets and replies in the thread chain.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tweetId` | string | ✅ Required | The unique ID of the tweet to fetch thread context for. Example: `2104402989570297895` |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/tweet/thread_context?tweetId=2104402989570297895
```

### Example Response

Returns the thread context including:
- `tweet` — The requested tweet object
- `ancestors` — Array of parent tweets in the thread
- `replies` — Array of direct replies in the thread
- Each tweet contains: `id`, `text`, `author`, `createdAt`, engagement metrics

## Get Article

Retrieves a Twitter/X Article (long-form content) by its associated tweet ID.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tweet_id` | string | ✅ Required | The tweet ID associated with the article. Example: `1905545699552375179` |

### Example Request

```
GET {{base_url}}/twitter/article?tweet_id=1905545699552375179
```

### Notes
- Twitter/X Articles are long-form posts published natively on the platform.
- The `tweet_id` is the ID of the tweet that links to or contains the article.

### Example Response

Returns an article object containing:
- `id` — Article ID
- `title` — Article title
- `content` — Full article content (HTML or Markdown)
- `author` — Author user object
- `createdAt` — Publication timestamp
- `coverImageUrl` — Cover image URL (if any)
- `tweetId` — Associated tweet ID
